description: MNN: A blazing-fast, lightweight inference engine battle-tested by Alibaba, powering high-performance on-device LLMs and Edge AI.

summary.one_liner: MNN is Alibaba's lightweight C++ deep learning inference and training engine, aimed at running models (including LLMs and diffusion models) on phones, PCs and embedded devices.
summary.what_it_does: MNN is a deep learning framework for running and training models on-device, with CPU backends for x86/x64 and ARM and GPU backends including OpenCL, Vulkan, Metal and CUDA. It converts models from TensorFlow, Caffe, ONNX and TorchScript into its own format and applies graph optimization, and it supports FP16, BF16 and Int8 quantization to shrink models. The README also describes MNN-LLM and MNN-Diffusion runtimes built on the engine for local large language and stable diffusion models, plus companion tools: MNN-Compress, MNN-Express for control-flow and general numeric computing, MNN-CV as a lightweight OpenCV-like image library, and MNN-Train. A Python API is provided. The README lists per-architecture support levels (S/A/B/C) for CPU, GPU and NPU backends.
use_cases: run large language models locally on a phone or PC
deploy stable diffusion image generation on-device
convert TensorFlow, ONNX or PyTorch models for mobile inference
quantize models to FP16 or Int8 to reduce size
GPU-accelerated inference with Metal, OpenCL, Vulkan or CUDA
edge AI on embedded or IoT devices
how_to_run: Read the MNN docs on Read the Docs or build the HTML docs from docs/README
Download MNN Workbench from the MNN homepage for pretrained models and one-click deployment
Build the engine from source following the documentation (build steps are not included in this README)
notable: Used in more than 30 Alibaba apps such as Taobao, Tmall, Youku and DingTalk, per the README
Ships MNN-LLM and MNN-Diffusion runtimes for local LLM and stable diffusion inference
Winograd convolution and hand-tuned assembly for ARM and x64 CPUs
Per-architecture support matrix rating CPU, GPU and NPU backends by precision
caveats: Official docs are largely in Chinese; community discussion is predominantly Chinese, though English speakers are welcome
Some backends are marked as limited support (B) or not supported (C) for certain precisions, per the matrix
MNN_BUILD_MINI reduces package size but fixes model input sizes
